scope: Generic Agent OCI Tenant destination binding. Tenant admission reserves one stable tenant_id -> repository destination; Build resolves its output repository from that binding instead of a global hashed path. IBD/OMA remains a reference sample only. No Instance deployment, provider mutation or real-money mutation.

proto: CreateTenantRequest.owner_email added as the initial repository-name candidate input only
tenant: services/gateway-integration/identity/create_tenant.go implements CreateTenant: platform-admin authorization, Tenant + owner membership + stable repository binding + durable Operation + immutable audit in one command transaction
services/gateway-integration/identity/repository_binding.go derives the slug candidate from the verified email local-part, resolves collisions with a deterministic suffix, and serves the binding read
build: services/build/internal/build/runner.go Runner.DestinationRepository joins the resolved binding into host/namespace/repository
services/build/internal/build/service.go CreateBuild reads the binding and persists <repository>:<job-id> as executor_ref, replacing the global-prefix + hashed Tenant/Package destination
implementation.migration: services/gateway-integration/migrations/0002_tenant_repository_binding.sql creates tenant.tenant_repository_bindings with a per-destination unique index, the installation registry facts, and the runtime writer grant
implementation.configuration: OPL_WORKSPACE_REGISTRY_HOST / OPL_WORKSPACE_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE are supplied together; a half-configured pair fails startup. They carry no credential.

focusedVerification.coverage: email local-part slug derivation and collision-safe candidate shape

real CreateTenant over isolated PostgreSQL: platform-admin gate, first Tenant reserves huangrende, a second same-local-part Tenant gets huangrende-1, re-read is stable, unknown Tenant is NotFound, Build and ConsoleBFF may read, Ledger may not

real owner chain with the Tenant-resolved destination: Capability upload, Runtime/WebUI admission, CreateBuild, three bound claims, BuildKit composition pushed to 127.0.0.1:<port>/result/tenant-live (host/namespace/repository), ready CapabilityVersion, Ledger receipts, lost-ack recovery, worker SIGKILL recovery, publisher browser

notProven: A Tencent/TKE-hosted Cloud Build pushing a Tenant-resolved destination to the customer personal-TCR repository.
That the existing oplcloud/huangrende artifact is the output of a recorded Build job; its digest differs from the recorded local Build artifact.
Physical repository materialization on personal TCR: no Build push has yet run against the real installation registry.
boundary: The single remaining hosted proof is a real Build on the deployed Cloud instance. Instance still deploys only one-person-lab-cloud and injects installation-level configuration; it does not run a per-application workflow.
